lines.speaker: board
lines.text: MOVE: W, A, S and D. DASH: SPACE gives a quick burst in the direction you are moving, then needs a moment to recharge.

lines.speaker: board
lines.text: INTERACT: E talks to people, reads boards, picks up loot and steps through doorways.

lines.speaker: board
lines.text: BAG: I opens your inventory. TAB picks the next potion and Q uses the one you have picked.

lines.speaker: board
lines.text: WEAPONS: 1 is the sword, 2 the knife, 3 the bow. J is a quick attack and K is a heavy attack.

lines.speaker: board
lines.text: ABILITIES: Hecate lets you carry one gift at a time. Once you have chosen, L uses it.

lines.speaker: board
lines.text: Head east for melee practice, north for archery, and north-east to practise dodging and dashing.
